stem: Which fraction is the same as 50%?
hints: Simplify 50/100 by dividing the top and the bottom by 50.

steps.action: Divide the top and the bottom by 50: 50 ÷ 50 = 1 and 100 ÷ 50 = 2.
steps.why: Dividing the top and the bottom by the same number keeps the value the same.

steps.action: 50/100 = 1/2, so 50% is the same as 1/2, or half.

trapNotes.1/5: This uses the 5 from 50. But 1/5 is 20%, not 50%.
trapNotes.1/50: This puts 50 on the bottom. 50% means 50 on top, out of 100.
trapNotes.5/100: This drops the zero from 50. 5/100 is 5%, not 50%.
